xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4960: Overdeck Anywhere: dashboard Account card with PKCE sign-in (Settings → Anywhere)

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere: dashboard Account card with PKCE sign-in (Settings → Anywhere)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 24 files (under the 25-file limit). The subsystem count of 8 comes from four single-file documentation touches the issue names (cli/account.mdx, configuration/remote-access.mdx, anywhere.mdx at the root, docs/ACCOUNT-SERVICE.md) and the one-line scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt fixture; the code itself spans only src/lib, src/dashboard and tests/unit. Splitting the docs into a sibling issue would ship the feature undocumented.

narratives.Problem: Signing a machine in to overdeck.ai needs the terminal (`pan account login`), and the dashboard has no place that shows which GitHub account the machine uses, its plan, its relay allowance, or a link to the overdeck.ai account page that PAN-4959 added.
narratives.Proposal: Add an Account card to Settings → Anywhere fed by a new GET /api/account (account.json + cached /v1/me entitlement + the directory client's plan and relay). Add a root-only, this-machine-only Sign in that runs the account service's existing PKCE loopback flow: POST /api/account/sign-in keeps the verifier in a single server-side pending slot and returns the /auth/start URL; GET /oauth/account/callback (loopback peers only, single-use state, 10-minute lifetime) exchanges the code, writes account.json like pan account login, and makes the directory client re-read it at once. The card uses a two-step link (no window.open) and polls while the sign-in is pending. Full design in .pan/drafts/PAN-4960.md (D-1 … D-16).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No Sign out button on the card; pan account logout stays the way to sign out.
- No change to the existing Add 50 GB link in AnywhereStatusCard.tsx.
- No change to the other pan account login hints (DirectoryPanel, SetUpPhoneAppPanel, ShareDialog, SharedConversationView, directory-inbox.ts, share-join.ts).
- No change to pan account login, status or logout behaviour or output.
- No [::1] or localhost redirect URI, and no sign-in from a browser on another device.
- No change to services/account or services/connect.
- No prices, checkout, upgrade or plan purchase anywhere on the card.
- No revocation of the previous device token when signing in again.
- No ROUTE_SCOPES scope rows for the new routes (comment only, D-13).

autoDecisions.summary: Callback path is GET /oauth/account/callback, outside /api/, checking the peer itself (loopback, no forwarding header, not Funnel → else 404).
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors /oauth/mcp/*; gate rule 1 already passes non-/api paths, so no REMOTE_GATE_ALLOWLIST row is needed and the route owns its check.

autoDecisions.summary: redirect_uri host is exactly 127.0.0.1 on API_PORT ?? PORT ?? 3011; a non-loopback HOST bind makes the start route answer 409.
autoDecisions.rationale: The default 0.0.0.0 bind is IPv4-only, so localhost resolving to ::1 would fail; the exact string must match at /oauth/token.

autoDecisions.summary: Start route requires a root credential AND isTrustedLocalRequest.
autoDecisions.rationale: A Tailscale Serve browser can hold a root session without require_token_mint, but its 127.0.0.1 redirect would land on the wrong device.

autoDecisions.summary: One pending sign-in slot, latest wins; mismatched state never clears it; matching state is consumed before any network call; 10-minute lifetime checked lazily with injected now().
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the account service's single-use code semantics and auth_requests expiry, and keeps tests free of real waits.

autoDecisions.summary: Two-step Sign in: POST returns the URL, the card renders an 'Open overdeck.ai sign-in' link and polls GET /api/account every 2 s while pending.
autoDecisions.rationale: window.open after an await is popup-blocked; TailscaleSetupDialog already uses this pattern; the callback tab is another origin and cannot notify the dashboard tab.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan comes from cached /v1/me entitlement (5-minute TTL per token, cleared on sign-in), falling back to the directory plan, else 'Shows when overdeck.ai is reachable'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue points at /v1/me's entitlement; a cache keeps the card from calling overdeck.ai on every poll.

autoDecisions.summary: Sign in shows only when signed out or the token was rejected; Manage account shows only when signed in.
autoDecisions.rationale: Manage account's base URL comes from account.json; the issue's goal is replacing pan account login for signed-out machines.

autoDecisions.summary: No ROUTE_SCOPES scope rows; a comment line names the three routes instead. Every route gets a NO_LOSS_MATRIX row.
autoDecisions.rationale: Unlisted routes already need admin and root-only routes deliberately have no row (agent-requests pattern); a scope row would let tokens past the gate only to hit the route's 403. Departs from the issue note's literal wording.

autoDecisions.summary: AccountView types live in the server service and are copied into the frontend accountApi.ts, not in @overdeck/contracts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same pattern as AnywhereStatus; avoids touching packages/contracts for a single consumer.

autoDecisions.summary: The Account card mounts directly after AnywhereStatusCard in AnywhereSection.
autoDecisions.rationale: Account state is top-level context for every panel below it.

Server-side pending PKCE sign-in service

Implement D-2, D-3, D-5, D-11, D-12, D-16 exactly; compare states with timingSafeEqual over SHA-256 digests; never put the verifier in a result, view or log.
